slices.name: taskloop-happy-path
slices.system_behavior: Plan (LLM fake) → decompose gate μ↓ → order next_node(deps) → delegate 1 worker scope⊆parent → worker fs_write/fs_read thật qua execute_tool → emit events.jsonl → judge_acceptance trên evidence thật → FINISHED; budget max_steps chạm → BLOCKED.
slices.visible_output: Outcome{status=FINISHED, run_id, evidence_ids(2 thật)} + events.jsonl seq gap-free chứa tool.requested/completed(N1,N2)+delegation.finished.
acceptance: AC-1 FINISHED với đúng 2 evidence THẬT (tool_result), 0 scaffolding tính
AC-2 events.jsonl: tool.requested/completed N1+N2 + delegation.finished, seq gap-free
AC-3 order: next_node trả N1 trước N2 (N2 depends_on N1)
AC-4 scope⊆parent property: ∀ child-cap ⊄ parent → REJECTED fail-closed
AC-5 μ↓: accept_decomposition chấp nhận chỉ khi μ co ngặt + coverage; RENAME(Jaccard>0.80)/STUCK bị từ chối
AC-6 budget: max_steps chạm → BLOCKED, không vượt K step (enforce ở discipline/loop)
AC-7 worker KHÔNG set verdict (audit): chỉ gate ghi acceptance
AC-8 no-bypass (audit): 0 call-site gọi tool/LLM ngoài execute_tool

plan_fake: N2(work,depends_on N1): fs_read out.txt → fs_write len.txt==len(X)
